run.access_mode: Playwright (scripts/progression.mjs) + save reads from localStorage; levels won by the game's auto-solve bot at 5x (assisted)
run.scope: Win flow and rewards, persistence, difficulty unlocks, daily rewards (7-day cycle), daily tasks, corrupted saves
run.summary: Progression and daily systems are solid: rewards, unlock boundaries, the 7-day calendar, tasks and backup-save recovery all pass. One major bug: the Level Complete popup can be dismissed by tapping outside it or pressing Escape, which skips the coin reward and leaves the player on an empty board.

coverage.notes: PR-W1 (Continue pays +30 and opens Level 2) passes; PR-W2 runs 1-4 reproduce BUG-001.
Stars and coins survive reload (PR-W1); purchases survive closing the tab (catalog CT-LIFE-1).
Medium locked at 5/6 Easy, unlocked at 6/6.
Day 1 +500 coins; same-day claim refused after reload; streak continues; missed days reset; Day 7 chest then back to Day 1.
Unfinished task disabled; finished task pays +150 once even when double-tapped.
Broken main slot: backup loaded (4,321 coins). Both slots broken: fresh start at the age gate, no errors.

Day changes were simulated by moving the last-claim date in the save. Changing the device clock or time zone was not tested (a frozen browser clock stalls the loading screen, which is a test-tool limit, not a game bug).

findings.title: Level Complete popup closes on a tap outside it or Escape: the coin reward is never paid and the player is left on an empty board
findings.environment: Web, 390x844 touch; 4 runs (2 tap outside, 2 Escape) in each of 3 sessions
steps: Win Flowers Easy level 1 (Level Complete shows '+30')
Tap anywhere outside the popup card (or press Escape on a keyboard)
findings.expected: The popup stays open until Continue or Claim x2 is chosen (like the Out of Slots popup, which is locked), or closing it pays the reward and moves on
findings.actual: The popup closes, coins stay at 100 (the +30 is lost), the board is empty and there is no Continue button. The win itself is saved (3 stars), so the player can only leave through Pause.

evidence.caption: Run 1 as stills: popup, tap, empty board
After the tap: empty board, coins still 100
coins 100 before and after, progress saved
<div class="overlay rays" id="popup-complete" hidden> (no data-locked; popup-fail at index.html:458 has it)

findings.suspected_cause: popup-complete lacks the data-locked attribute, so the generic outside-tap and Escape handlers (app.js:237, 3028) close it without calling finishWin().
findings.suggested_fix: Add data-locked to #popup-complete (index.html:423), as #popup-fail already has.
